what_it_is: Net calorific value of Indian non-coking coal by grade G1-G17
india_specific_source: Ministry of Coal grade GCV bands; peer-reviewed India-specific NCV/CEF studies
validation_rule: MUST be grade- or measurement-specific. Grade bands are on an EQUILIBRATED basis (60% RH, 40C) - not interchangeable with lab as-received values. Store the basis.

what_it_is: NCV of imported steam / coking coal
india_specific_source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors (DESNZ) fuels table
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: NCV of diesel, petrol, FO, LDO, kerosene, naphtha, ATF, LPG
india_specific_source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors (DESNZ) fuels table; IS 1448 test methods
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: NCV of natural gas, CNG, PNG, LNG, biogas, process gases
validation_rule: State net or gross basis explicitly; ~10% difference for gas

what_it_is: NCV of bagasse, rice husk, groundnut shell, briquettes, wood
validation_rule: Moisture basis must be recorded; as-received vs dry changes this substantially

what_it_is: Published GCV to NCV relationship per fuel class
validation_rule: Store as a sourced coefficient, never a hardcoded rule of thumb

what_it_is: Density of diesel / HSD
validation_rule: Required for any L<->kg conversion. Conversion must RAISE without it.

what_it_is: Density of petrol / gasoline
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Density of furnace oil / HFO
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Density of LPG
india_specific_source: Sold by mass in India, volume in UK
validation_rule: The single most common mass/volume trap in the catalogue

what_it_is: Densities of naphtha, kerosene/SKO, LDO
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Reference conditions for scm vs Nm3
validation_rule: scm and Nm3 differ ~5%; define both explicitly

what_it_is: Carbon content of coal by category
exact_reference: Vol.2 Ch.1 Table 1.3 (carbon content, kg C/GJ) and Table 1.4 (default CO2 EF, kg/TJ at OF=1)
india_specific_source: Peer-reviewed revised India-specific CEFs by coal category
validation_rule: Tier 2 method REQUIRED for Indian coal

what_it_is: CO2 emission factor, stationary combustion, all fuels
india_specific_source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors (DESNZ) (physical basis alternative)
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: CH4 and N2O factors, stationary combustion
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: CO2/CH4/N2O by vehicle class, fuel and control technology
india_specific_source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors (DESNZ) vehicle tables
validation_rule: CH4/N2O differ materially from stationary; do not reuse

what_it_is: Aviation, marine and rail combustion factors
exact_reference: Vol.2 Ch.3 Sec 3.4 railways, 3.5 water-borne navigation, 3.6 civil aviation
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Off-road mobile plant factors
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: CaO fraction in clinker
exact_reference: Vol.3 Ch.2 Sec 2.2.1.2 (Eq 2.4); Table 2.1 for carbonate stoichiometry; Table 2.2 for clinker fraction
validation_rule: EF_clinker = CaO_frac x 0.7848. Multiply by CLINKER not cement.

what_it_is: Cement kiln dust correction factor
exact_reference: Vol.3 Ch.2 Eq 2.5 (CF_ckd), applied in Eq 2.2; default 1.02
validation_rule: Omitting this understates cement process CO2

what_it_is: CaO and MgO fractions in lime
validation_rule: EF = CaO x 0.785 + MgO x 1.092, then x CF_lkd (default 1.02) x C_h, applied PER LIME TYPE

what_it_is: Carbon in/out coefficients for iron and steel
validation_rule: MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with the coke/BF gas/COG fuel rows

what_it_is: Ammonia, nitric acid, adipic acid factors
validation_rule: Nitric and adipic acid are N2O-only, not CO2

what_it_is: Anode consumption and PFC (CF4, C2F6) factors
validation_rule: PFC only for anode-effect row

what_it_is: Carbonate decomposition factors
exact_reference: Vol.3 Ch.2 Sec 2.4 glass (Table 2.6) and Sec 2.5 other carbonate uses (Table 2.7)
validation_rule: CO2 only

what_it_is: GWP100 values, AR6, all gases
primary_source: IPCC AR6 WG1 Ch.7 / GHG Protocol GWP table (Aug 2024)
india_specific_source: Also required: AR5 and AR4 sets for CDP and legacy baselines
validation_rule: VERSIONED DATA, not a constant. Fossil CH4 29.8 vs non-fossil 27.0 are DIFFERENT; store which non-fossil value you chose (27.0 vs the argued 27.9) as a cited field.

what_it_is: Component composition of refrigerant blends
validation_rule: AR6 publishes pure species only. Blend GWP = mass-weighted average. Store the derivation.

what_it_is: CH4 and N2O from on-site wastewater treatment
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Indian grid weighted average emission rate
primary_source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
exact_reference: Current User Guide version, weighted average tables
validation_rule: Use the WEIGHTED AVERAGE, not OM/BM/combined margin (those are CDM baselines)

what_it_is: Grid factors for UK, EU, US, rest of world
validation_rule: Keyed by (region, year); annual re-ingest required

what_it_is: Residual mix factors
validation_rule: Where unpublished, substitute grid average and footnote it explicitly in the report

what_it_is: Transmission and distribution loss rate by region
validation_rule: Apply as C x L/(1-L), NOT C x L

what_it_is: Purchased steam, heat and chilled water factors
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Well-to-tank factors for every Scope 1 fuel and Scope 2 electricity
validation_rule: Auto-derived; no user input

what_it_is: Freight factors by mode: road, rail, sea, air, courier
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Waste factors by material and treatment route
exact_reference: Vol.5 Ch.3 solid waste disposal, Ch.4 biological treatment, Ch.5 incineration; Ch.2 for composition data
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Air by haul band and cabin class, rail, road, hotel
validation_rule: Air needs a detour uplift on great-circle distance

what_it_is: Commuting factors by mode
india_specific_source: Indian two-wheeler and auto-rickshaw factors need a local source
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: Material factors: steel, cement, aluminium, plastics, paper, glass
validation_rule: Primary vs secondary aluminium differ ~10x

what_it_is: Spend-based EEIO factors by sector
india_specific_source: Indian input-output derived set if available
validation_rule: Record the factor's base year AND currency; deflation is mandatory

what_it_is: Dated currency conversion rates
validation_rule: Stored with the date used

what_it_is: Producer/consumer price index series for deflation
validation_rule: Required to deflate spend to the factor base year

what_it_is: PPP conversion factor, USD/INR
validation_rule: REQUIRED by BRSR Core for PPP-adjusted turnover intensity

what_it_is: Enteric fermentation, manure, fertiliser N2O, rice cultivation
exact_reference: Vol.4 Ch.5 Sec 5.5 rice cultivation; Ch.10 livestock and manure; Ch.11 managed soils, lime and urea
validation_rule: within +/-40% of prior-year value, else human review

what_it_is: CaO in clinker derived from NON-carbonate raw materials (fly ash, GGBS, steel slag)
india_specific_source: Plant raw-meal analysis - material for Indian blended cement
validation_rule: SUBTRACTED from the CaO fraction. Opposite sign to the organic-carbon correction. Two separate fields.
